title: Stock market holiday on Muharram: Will NSE, BSE remain closed for trading on June 26?
summary: Stock market investors, mark your calendars! The market will be closed on Friday, June 26, for Muharram.
title_hi: Stock Market Holiday 2026 : लगातार तीन दिन बंद रहेगा शेयर बाजार , कल भी है NSE और BSE की छुट्टी , जानें क्यों नहीं होगा कारोबार
